clocks.state: seconds, native clock; time/qpos/qvel after the final substep of each action
clocks.physics: force_time is before integration, state_time is after integration; both seconds
clocks.measurements: derived native observations from the last pre-integration substep; their actual epoch is column 0
clocks.video: seconds relative to native initial time 0.25; exact control-rate recorded states at 20 Hz

frames_and_units.qpos: MuJoCo model order; translation m, hinge rad, free orientation unit wxyz quaternion
frames_and_units.qvel: MuJoCo model order; translation m/s, rotation rad/s; free-joint angular velocity in local body frame
frames_and_units.object_position: world frame, m; free body origin, not center of mass
frames_and_units.object_com_offset: body_ipos is body-frame m; used with quaternion and angular velocity in COM momentum score
frames_and_units.relative_object_position: end-effector frame, m; includes rotation and release and is not pure slip
frames_and_units.contact_frame: rows are world vectors of contact normal and tangent axes; local wrench acts on geom2
frames_and_units.contact_force: world N on target, sign reversed when target is geom1
frames_and_units.contact_torque: world Nm about target free-body origin; translational scorer does not certify rotational balance
frames_and_units.finger_normal: sum of actual target/finger contact normal-force magnitudes, N; not actuator command
frames_and_units.actions: six normalized OSC pose commands plus native gripper command; scaling recorded in controller readback
frames_and_units.controller_targets: native OSC world goal position in m and orientation rotation matrix
frames_and_units.controls: native actuator order: seven Panda torque commands Nm; two finger position-servo targets m, bounded to [0,0.04] and [-0.04,0]
frames_and_units.actuator_force: native actuator output: seven Panda torques Nm; two finger forces N, each limited to [-20,20]; distinct from ctrl and contact force
frames_and_units.qfrc_actuator: generalized force in native DOF order; hinge Nm, translation N

parameter_readback: before/effective/after retain full floating precision; MJCF exports can round values and are visualization inputs only
contact_reference: contact.solref is the mixed reference. effective_timeconst_s is derived from the pinned refsafe code, not a separate native sensor; max(solref[0],2*h) for positive format with refsafe enabled
limits: No historical controller-memory reconstruction, mid-episode restoration qualification, learned-policy closed-loop evaluation, measured material validation or additional reliable coverage. Published dataset done/reward flags are not used as success evidence.
